environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.xlarge) in us-east-1 VPC running the legacy monolith as a Docker container. Instance profile 'LegacyMonolithRole' has sts:AssumeRole with Resource '*'. IMDSv1 enabled (HttpTokens: optional). Container port 8080 is exposed to the VPC via internal ALB. No network policies restrict intra-VPC traffic. The INTERNAL_ADMIN_TOKEN environment variable is set to the default value 'legacy-default-token-2019'. Any pod/instance in the VPC can reach port 8080.

config.network: internal ALB, no network restrictions within VPC
